'''catman421 Maine Tournament Light Runner-up''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[catman421]]
* '''Published:''' 31 July 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 HB catman421 LS 2003 MaineTou 4718.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I placed second using this deck.

The published list has 69 cards.

== Strategy ==

Round 1-

Lost to Senate TIEs.  Couldn't get enough starships out, and was outdrained.

Round 2-

Beat a bounty hunter deck.  Nearly lost, since my system was found.  Saved by Wolking (V).

Round 3-

Beat MKOS deck.  Won drain race through Battle Order Shield.
